Start here. This page sets up **the starter** with _one_ command.

<Callout type="note" title="Before you start">
Install Node first.
</Callout>

## Setup

Run the [installer](https://example.com/install) and open `astro.config.mjs`.

```sh
# not a heading
pnpm create astro --template minimal
```
